# AVR, checked against avr-elf-as -mmcu=avrtiny (GNU binutils 2.47): the
# reduced core of the ATtiny4-40, with only r16-r31 and one-word lds and sts
# that reach 0x40-0xbf. Every lds and sts form, and a few of every other
# instruction, which encode as they do in avr.txt. One statement per line.

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
clc
clh
cli
cln
cls
clt
clv
clz
sec
seh
sei
sen
ses
set
sev
sez

# ---- SREG bit set and clear ------------------------------------------------
bclr 0
bclr 1
bclr 5
bset 0
bset 1
bset 5

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
icall
ijmp
nop
ret
reti
sleep
break
wdr

# ---- two registers ---------------------------------------------------------
adc r31,r31
adc R16, R17
adc xl, zh
add r31,r31
add R16, R17
add xl, zh
and r31,r31
and R16, R17
and xl, zh
cp r31,r31
cp R16, R17
cp xl, zh
cpc r31,r31
cpc R16, R17
cpc xl, zh
cpse r31,r31
cpse R16, R17
cpse xl, zh
eor r31,r31
eor R16, R17
eor xl, zh
mov r31,r31
mov R16, R17
mov xl, zh
or r31,r31
or R16, R17
or xl, zh
sbc r31,r31
sbc R16, R17
sbc xl, zh
sub r31,r31
sub R16, R17
sub xl, zh

# ---- one register standing for two -----------------------------------------
clr r16
clr r17
clr r23
lsl r16
lsl r17
lsl r23
rol r16
rol r17
rol r23
tst r16
tst r17
tst r23

# ---- 8-bit immediates, with and without modifiers --------------------------
andi r16, 0x55
andi r17, 0x55
andi r24, 0x55

# ---- cbr, a complemented andi ----------------------------------------------
cbr r16, 0x55
cbr r17, 0x55
cbr r24, 0x55

# ---- 8-bit immediates, with and without modifiers --------------------------
ldi r16, 0x55
ldi r17, 0x55
ldi r24, 0x55

# ---- ser -------------------------------------------------------------------
ser r16
ser r17
ser r24

# ---- 8-bit immediates, with and without modifiers --------------------------
ori r16, 0x55
ori r17, 0x55
ori r24, 0x55
sbr r16, 0x55
sbr r17, 0x55
sbr r24, 0x55
cpi r16, 0x55
cpi r17, 0x55
cpi r24, 0x55
sbci r16, 0x55
sbci r17, 0x55
sbci r24, 0x55
subi r16, 0x55
subi r17, 0x55
subi r24, 0x55

# ---- register bits ---------------------------------------------------------
sbrc r16, 0
sbrc r16, 1
sbrc r16, 5
sbrs r16, 0
sbrs r16, 1
sbrs r16, 5
bld r16, 0
bld r16, 1
bld r16, 5

bst r16, 1
bst r16, 5

# ---- I/O ports -------------------------------------------------------------
in r16, 0
in r16, 1
in r16, 0x1f
out 0, r16
out 1, r16
out 0x1f, r16

# ---- I/O bits --------------------------------------------------------------
cbi 0, 0

# ---- direct load and store -------------------------------------------------
sts 0x40, r20
sts 0x41, r20
sts 0x7f, r20
sts 0x80, r20
sts 0xbf, r20
sts 0x60, r16
sts 0x60, r31
lds r20, 0x40
lds r20, 0x41
lds r20, 0x7f
lds r20, 0x80
lds r20, 0xbf
lds r16, 0x60
lds r31, 0x60

# ---- load and store through a pointer --------------------------------------
ld r16, X
ld r16, X+
ld r16, -X
st X, r16
st X+, r16
st -X, r16
